Title: Expansion of the password character limit in Azure AD

Body.Content:
Previously, accounts created in Azure AD had a 16 character password limit while those created in Windows Server Active Directory had a longer limit. Now, the Azure AD accounts can have passwords up to 256 characters including spaces.

Read the tech community blog to learn more.
